newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays firm, ends at resistance.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays firm, ends at resistance.

text.p: London's spot March white sugar contract finished at the $300 resistance after a light day's trading which mainly comprised of against actuals and crossed trades, market sources said on Thursday.

Commission house crosses were noted on the outright March and May contracts after a March/May cross earlier in the session. A large AA trade on March also helped to boost the overall volume, they said.
But otherwise activity was subdued across the board.
March closed $2.10 higher at $300.00 and May was up $1.30 at $298.90. March volume totalled 1,585 lots and May 492 lots.

In fundamental news, the European Union revised down its forecast of this season's C-quota exports to 1.58 million tonnes from a previous estimate of 1.60 million, due to a reduction in the German production estimate.
But the forecast for the trading bloc's overall sugar output for 1996 was left broadly unchanged at 15.58 million tonnes.
Paris futures also clawed their way higher but volume was light. March was up $0.80 at $299.00 and May up $1.00 at $298.70.
